title: gpucohp: GPU projection of plane-wave wavefunctions onto local orbitals for COHP analysis
description: gpucohp projects VASP PAW wavefunctions onto atom-centred Slater-type orbitals on a GPU and writes pDOS, pCOOP, pCOHP, COBI and Mulliken/Löwdin charges in LOBSTER's file formats. It follows the projection scheme of Maintz et al. (J. Comput. Chem. 2013, 2016) and reproduces LOBSTER 5.1.1 on the same inputs; see README and benchmarks/.
